bojim.englishDescription: bundle: A bundle wrapped in a cloth.

dosa.englishDescription: A person who conducts gut, exorcisms, and tell another's fortune.

dotjari.definitionKo: 풀의 줄기를 넓은 직사각형 모양으로 엮어 만든, 앉거나 누울 자리에 바닥에 까는 물건.
dotjari.englishDescription: A rug made by weaving grass in a rectangular shape in order to spread it out so people can sit or lie down on it.

eojjeodaga.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '어찌하다가' (a conjugated form of '어찌하다').

eulalia.definitionKo: 말려서 지붕을 덮는 데나 짐승의 먹이로 쓰이는, 잎이 긴 선 모양이며 키가 큰 풀.
eulalia.englishDescription: A tall plant with long and thin leaves, which is dried and then used to cover a roof, or feed animals.

finger-wagging.definitionKo: 상대를 향해 주먹이나 손가락을 힘차게 뻗음.
finger-wagging.englishDescription: An act of stretching out a finger or fist at the other party.

loan.englishDescription: An act of lending or borrowing money or goods.

loan.definitionKo: 남에게 빌려 써서 갚아야 하는 돈.
loan.englishDescription: Money that one must repay because he/she had borrowed it.
The money lent at a fixed interest rate for a set period of time.
Lending money at a fixed interest rate for a set period of time.
To lend money at a fixed interest rate for a set period of time.

loan.definitionKo: 은행 등의 금융 기관에서 빌려주는 돈.
loan.englishDescription: The money a financial institution such as a bank, etc., lends.

loan.definitionKo: 은행 등의 금융 기관에서 돈을 빌려줌. 또는 그 돈.
loan.englishDescription: An act of a financial institution such as a bank, etc., lending money, or such money.

loan.definitionKo: 은행 등의 금융 기관에서 돈을 빌려주다.
loan.englishDescription: For a financial institution such as a bank, etc., to lend money.

loan.definitionKo: 돈이나 물건 등을 다른 곳에서 빌리거나 구해서 씀.
loan.englishDescription: Borrowing or obtain money or goods from another place and using them.

loan.definitionKo: 돈이나 물건 등을 다른 곳에서 빌리거나 구해서 쓰다.
loan.englishDescription: To borrow or obtain money or goods from another place and use them.
An act of borrowing money, objects, etc.
An act of borrowing money or objects from an external source.
Money borrowed from an external source.

loan.definitionKo: 한 나라가 다른 나라나 국제기구로부터 일정 기간 동안 자금을 빌려 옴. 또는 그 자금.
loan.englishDescription: An act of a nation borrowing funds for a certain period of time from another nation or an international agency, or such borrowed funds.

loan.definitionKo: 돈이나 이자를 받고 집이나 돈, 쌀 등을 빌려주다.
loan.englishDescription: To lend someone a house, money, rice, etc., for money or at interest.

lonely.definitionKo: 세상에 혼자 있는 듯이 외롭고 쓸쓸하다.
lonely.englishDescription: Feeling lonesome and solitary as if one is alone in the world.

lonely.definitionKo: 혼자가 되거나 의지할 데가 없어서 쓸쓸하다.
lonely.englishDescription: Being lonesome because one is alone or has nobody to depend on.
Feeling bored with nothing to do.
Being lighthearted without being bothered by something, or feeling lonely and cheerless.
Having a feeling that something is missing.
Being wide and empty, making one feel lonely.

lonely.definitionKo: 주변에 아무것도 없어서 텅 빈 느낌이 있다.
lonely.englishDescription: Showing a feeling of emptiness because there is no one around.

lonely.definitionKo: 의지할 곳이 없어지거나 무엇을 잃은 것처럼 서운한 느낌이 있다.
lonely.englishDescription: Having a feeling of sadness as if one has lost someone that one depended on or because something is missing.
Having a feeling that something is missing.

malbok.definitionKo: 음력 6월에서 7월에 있는 삼복 가운데 마지막 날. 대개 중복의 열흘 후이다.
malbok.englishDescription: The last of the three dog days of summer, days of midsummer heat, around the 6th and 7th months by the lunar calendar; this period usually comes ten days after the second dog day of summer.

metaphoric.definitionKo: 문학에서, 직접 말하지 않고 다른 말로 바꾸어 암시적으로 나타내는.
metaphoric.englishDescription: In literature, expressing something implicitly by using another expression without stating it directly.

mirage.definitionKo: 공기 중에서 빛이 굴절되어 공중이나 땅 위에 실제로는 있지 않는 사물의 모습이 나타나 보이는 현상.
mirage.englishDescription: A phenomenon in which an object not existing in the sky or ground seems to appear due to the refraction of light in the air.

mirage.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 아무 근거나 바탕이 없는 사물이나 생각.
mirage.englishDescription: (figurative) A groundless or baseless object or phenomenon.

mirage.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 갑자기 나타나서 잠깐 있다가 사라지는 아름답고 환상적인 일.
mirage.englishDescription: (figurative) A beautiful and fantastic phenomenon that appears suddenly, lingers for a while, and then disappears.

monochrome.definitionKo: 검은색의 짙고 옅음으로 이루어진 색의 상태.
monochrome.englishDescription: A state of color composed of the brightness and darkness of black.

parliament.definitionKo: 국민의 대표인 국회 의원들로 이루어져, 법률을 만들고 행정부와 사법부를 감시하는 기능을 하는 국가 기관.
parliament.englishDescription: A government body composed of lawmakers representing the people, which is in charge of making laws and supervising the Executive and Judiciary branches.

parliament.definitionKo: 국민의 선거로 뽑힌 의원들이 법을 제정하거나 중요한 일을 논의하고 의사를 결정하는 기관.
parliament.englishDescription: A body in which assemblymen elected by people enact laws, discuss significant matters, or make decisions.

present.definitionKo: 윗사람에게 인사, 말, 절 등을 하거나 무엇을 건네다.
present.englishDescription: To greet, make a bow or speak to one's superior, or hand something to him/her.

present.definitionKo: 예배, 기도, 제사 등을 드리다.
present.englishDescription: To hold a service or ceremony or offer a prayer.

present.definitionKo: 무엇을 하고자 하는 생각을 말이나 글로 나타내어 보이다.
present.englishDescription: To show one's plans to do something in speech or writing.

present.definitionKo: 고마움을 표현하거나 어떤 일을 축하하기 위해 다른 사람에게 물건을 줌. 또는 그 물건.
present.englishDescription: The act of giving an object to another person in order to show thanks or celebrate something, or the object itself.

present.definitionKo: 윗사람에게 자신이 가지고 있던 물건을 꺼내어 주다.
present.englishDescription: To take out and give something one possessed to one's superior.

present.definitionKo: 사람을 무대 등에 나타나게 하다.
present.englishDescription: To make a person appear on stage, etc.

present.definitionKo: 중요한 일이나 분야에서 새로운 사물이나 인물, 현상을 세상에 처음으로 나타나게 하다.
present.englishDescription: To present a new object, person, or phenomenon in an important matter or area for the first time.

present.definitionKo: 소설, 연극, 영화 등에 어떤 인물을 나타나게 하다.
present.englishDescription: To make a character appear in a novel, play, movie, etc.

present.definitionKo: 일정한 목적을 가지고 물건을 보게 하거나 사람을 만나게 하다.
present.englishDescription: To make a person look at a thing or meet another person with a certain purpose.

present.definitionKo: 작품이나 상품 등을 발표하다.
present.englishDescription: To release or announce a piece of work or prize, etc.

present.definitionKo: 생각이나 의견을 제시하다.
present.englishDescription: To propose an idea, opinion, etc.

present.definitionKo: 지금 이때.
present.englishDescription: The present time.

present.definitionKo: 문법에서, 말하는 순간이나 기준이 되는 어떤 때에 일어나고 있는 사건이나 행동, 상태를 나타내는 것.
present.englishDescription: In grammar, a tense that indicates a current event, action, and state occurring at the moment of speaking or a certain time.

present.definitionKo: 회의에서 토의할 안건을 내어놓다.
present.englishDescription: To introduce a discussion topic in a meeting.

present.definitionKo: 물건이나 사람 등이 처음 모습을 드러내다.
present.englishDescription: For an item, person, etc., to make its or his/her first appearance.

present.definitionKo: 존경이나 사랑 등의 마음을 나타내기 위해 남에게 물건을 주거나 어떤 행동을 해 좋은 감정을 느끼게 해 주다.
present.englishDescription: To give an object to, or perform an act of kindness for, someone in order to show one's respect, love, etc., and to make him/her feel good.

present.definitionKo: 공식적으로 증서, 상장, 훈장 등을 주다.
present.englishDescription: To officially give a certificate, award, medal, etc.

present.definitionKo: 고마움을 나타내거나 예의를 갖추기 위해서 보내는 물건.
present.englishDescription: Things sent to someone for expressing one's gratitude or being polite.

present.definitionKo: 현재의. 또는 지금의.
present.englishDescription: Current or present.

present.definitionKo: 보고 듣거나 즐길 수 있도록 사람들 앞에 관심을 집중시킬 만한 상태로 나타내다.
present.englishDescription: To express something in an interesting manner, so that people can watch, listen to, or enjoy it.

present.definitionKo: 추상적이거나 드러나지 않은 것을 구체적인 모양으로 나타내다.
present.englishDescription: To express something abstract or hidden in a concrete form.

shamelessness.definitionKo: 체면을 차릴 줄 알거나 부끄러움을 아는 마음이 없음.
shamelessness.englishDescription: A state in which one is ignorant about saving face, or lacks a sense of shame.

shamelessness.definitionKo: 체면을 차릴 줄 알거나 부끄러움을 아는 마음이 없음.
shamelessness.englishDescription: A state in which one is ignorant about saving face, or lacks a sense of shame.
A state in which one is impudent, lacking a sense of shame.
A state of being ignorant about saving face and lacking a sense of shame.

soldering.definitionKo: 납을 녹여 금속과 금속을 이어 붙이거나 금속에 난 구멍을 때움.
soldering.englishDescription: The act of affixing a piece of metal to another or filling in a hole in the metal using melted solder.

soldering.definitionKo: 구멍이나 틈이 생긴 곳을 다른 것으로 대어 막는 일.
soldering.englishDescription: The act of blocking a hole or gap with another thing.

soldering.definitionKo: 구멍이나 틈이 생긴 곳을 다른 것으로 대어 막는 일.
soldering.englishDescription: The act of blocking a hole or gap with another thing.

soldering.definitionKo: 구멍이나 틈이 생긴 곳을 다른 것으로 대어 막음.
soldering.englishDescription: The act of covering a hole or gap with certain material.

stopover.definitionKo: 목적지로 가는 도중에 잠깐 들르는 곳.
stopover.englishDescription: A place to stop by temporarily on the way to a destination.

stopover.definitionKo: 목적지에 가는 도중 어떤 곳을 들르거나 지나감.
stopover.englishDescription: The act of visiting or passing by a certain place enroute to a destination.

stopover.definitionKo: 목적지에 가는 도중 들르거나 지나가는 곳.
stopover.englishDescription: An area a passenger or traveler drops by or passes through.
The act of getting out of a car before reaching one's destination.

stopover.definitionKo: 목적지에 이르기 위해 거쳐 가는 공간.
stopover.englishDescription: An intermediate place that is traveled to before reaching a destination.

wet.englishDescription: Feeling or looking a little wet because of moisture.
To dampen something by dipping it in water, etc.
Feeling or looking wet because of moisture.
Rice, dough, etc., being soggy or damp.

wet.definitionKo: 물 등의 액체를 묻혀 젖게 하다.
wet.englishDescription: To cause something to come in contact with water and become wet.
Something being soft and tender due to the heat or moisture which has soaked into it.

yip.definitionKo: 강아지 등이 놀라거나 아파서 짖는 소리.
yip.englishDescription: A word imitating the yelping sound a dog makes out of fear or pain.

yip.definitionKo: 개가 무섭거나 아파서 자꾸 소리를 지르다.
yip.englishDescription: For a dog to make yelping sounds out of fear or pain.

yip.definitionKo: 강아지 등이 놀라거나 아파서 자꾸 짖다.
yip.englishDescription: For a puppy, etc., to cry out due to fear or pain.
A word mimicking the yelping sound a dog makes out of fear or pain.

yip.definitionKo: 개가 무섭거나 아파서 자꾸 소리를 지르다.
yip.englishDescription: For a dog to make yelping sounds out of fear or pain.

yip.definitionKo: 개가 무섭거나 아파서 자꾸 소리를 지르다.
yip.englishDescription: For a dog to make yelping sounds out of fear or pain.
